variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.sub: The colony has seen a strike collapse.
variants.body:
A strike has collapsed in {colony}. The collapse is a result for the labour action, not an established agreement about the underlying dispute. Readers judging {target} should avoid treating it as proof of a particular settlement, a change in wages or a complete account of responsibility.

The strike has collapsed. It is an ending, but do not turn it into a fairy tale in which every question has been solved. People can lose an action without losing the right to be heard. Readers deserve a plain account, not an invented villain to explain an unwelcome result.

The role of {target} merits examination without treating collapse as a full explanation. This paper records the outcome of the action while leaving unreported causes and terms outside the factual account. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.sub: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse.
variants.body:
